[
زَاجِرَةٌ a subst. formed from the epithet زَاجِرٌ by the addition of ة. Its pl. occurs in the saying,] كَرِّرَتْ عَلَى سَمْعِهِ المَوَاعِظُ وَالزَّوَاجِرُ (tropical:) [Exhortations, and chiding or restraining speeches, were repeated in his ears]. (A, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
